name: Advanced Filesystem: AI Visual Embeddings
description: Generates self-contained visual embeddings for managed images (colour, structure & texture via PHP-GD, no external service required), finds visually similar images, detects near-duplicates by perceptual hash, clusters and maps the collection, and — optionally, opt-in — enriches images with an AI description, tags, a text embedding and a safety label through the drupal/ai provider abstraction.

suggests.drupal/ai: ^1.0 — required only for the optional AI semantic enrichment (vision description, tags, text embedding, safety label). The core visual embedding works without it.
suggests.ext-gd: PHP GD is required to decode images and compute the visual embedding, perceptual hashes and reverse-image search.

project_description: Advanced Filesystem: AI Visual Embeddings is a submodule of Advanced FileSystem that turns a Drupal image library into a searchable, deduplicated, self-describing collection. Its VisualEmbeddingService builds a deterministic 127-dimension feature vector directly from image pixels with PHP-GD — an 8x8 luminance structure grid (flip-folded), HSV colour histograms, a 3x3 regional-colour grid and a 4x4 edge-texture grid, all L2-normalised — plus a DCT perceptual hash (pHash) and a difference hash (dHash) for near-duplicate detection, and a heuristic quality score with flags (too dark, overexposed, low detail, flat colour, low resolution). No external service is needed for any of that. On top of the vectors it offers cosine-similarity 'visually similar' listings, an optional cron precompute of top-K neighbours, reverse-image search from an in-memory upload, by-colour search, perceptual-hash duplicate grouping, a 2D PCA embedding map and deterministic k-means clustering. A separate, strictly opt-in AiEnrichmentService (disabled by default) uses the drupal/ai module's provider abstraction to ask a vision chat model for a short description, tags and an optional safety judgement, then embeds the description with the text-embeddings operation to give a semantic vector that complements the pixel-based one, enabling hybrid (visual + meaning) similarity. The module exposes all data through an admin UI (settings, batch analyse, log, per-file page, search, duplicates, map, clusters), a permission-gated JSON API for headless front-ends, Views integration, a Media source plugin and Drush commands. All UI and API routes require restricted admin permissions.
